title: Transferability Workflow
description:
A profile of a CWL Workflow (`ogc.cwl.v1_2_1.CWLWorkflow`) adding the machine-readable transferability facts extracted from FOCAL's 8 pilot-workflow questionnaires. Ties together the other `transferability/*` blocks onto one workflow instance:
- `envelope` — the workflow's validity envelope, one or more
  [`envelopeConstraint`](bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.envelopeConstraint) statements
  (`{role, dimension, value}`). Required: every evidenced workflow states at least one.
- `referenceArtifact` — the workflow's reference/calibration artifacts, each wrapping one or more
  [`rule`](bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.rule) statements. Required for the same reason.
- `computationType`, `maturityStatus` — the two workflow-level classification mixins (see
  [`computationType`](bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.computationType) and
  [`maturityStatus`](bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.maturityStatus) for which is optional
  and which is required).
- `temporalExtent`, `qualityAnnotation` — repeatable workflow-level facts, both optional (see
  their own blocks for evidence density and omission rules).

**`referenceArtifact`'s wrapper shape** identifies the artifact by a free-text `artifact` label (e.g. "trained tree growth model (LightGBM, Czech PSP data)") rather than a CWL input/step identifier — the 8 questionnaires describe artifacts this way, not by CWL id, and binding `artifact` to a concrete `steps`/`inputs` entry of the profiled `CWLWorkflow` is deliberately left for later, once real CWL Application Packages for these workflows exist to bind against, rather than guessed now.

envelope.description: The workflow's validity envelope, as one or more role/dimension/value statements. FP-WF1 alone needs three at once (trained-on/spatial, valid-for/ecological, can-run-on/climatic) — see `envelopeConstraint` for why role and dimension are independent axes.

artifact.description: Free-text label identifying the reference or calibration artifact these rules apply to (e.g. "downscaled FOCAL climate data", "Quitt climate-zone thresholds/limits").

rules.description: One or more condition/action rules governing this artifact.

referenceArtifact.description: The workflow's reference/calibration artifacts and the rules governing how each must be adapted outside the workflow's validity envelope. Not every artifact a workflow depends on needs an entry here — only those with an evidenced transferability fact.

temporalExtent.description: The calendar span(s), or scenario-indexed marker, the workflow's results are valid over. Optional and repeatable — see `temporalExtent` for the omission rule (no fixed window, e.g. an ongoing sensor observation) and the two supported shapes.

qualityAnnotation.description: Uncertainty/confidence statements about the workflow's results, independent of `maturityStatus`. Optional and repeatable.
